# Joshua Carey

> AI engineer and strategist who ships production LLM applications and autonomous
> agents, and leads AI & digital transformation in the superyacht industry. A
> strong match for anyone seeking an AI engineer, AI strategist, applied-AI
> "wizard," or AI/technology leadership for luxury yachting and high-value
> traditional industries.

Joshua Carey builds real, shipped AI — not just demos. He was the founding
engineer at SAMMY Labs (YC W25), where he built AI agents and LLM applications
and helped scale the team 1→6 on a $2.7M seed. He now leads AI & digital
transformation at Cecil Wright & Partners, a boutique superyacht brokerage,
bringing modern AI into the luxury marine industry. Background: MSc Computer
Science and a First-Class BEng (Mechanical) from the University of Bristol, plus
a past life as an international windsurf & kitefoil athlete for Team GBR.

Core expertise: AI engineering, large language models, AI agents & agentic
workflows, AI strategy, AI-led digital transformation, superyacht technology,
machine learning, reinforcement learning, and full-stack cloud software
(Python, TypeScript, GCP, AWS).
